evidence.quote: The Committee decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent
Inflation has risen, largely reflecting transitory factors.
Amid progress on vaccinations and strong policy support, indicators of economic activity and employment have strengthened.
the Federal Reserve will continue to increase its holdings of Treasury securities by at least $80 billion per month and of agency mortgage‑backed securities by at least $40 billion per month
The ongoing public health crisis continues to weigh on the economy, and risks to the economic outlook remain.

parsed.rationale: The statement keeps rates at zero with outcome-based guidance and continued large-scale asset purchases, and it dismisses rising inflation as transitory. Improvement in activity tempers the dovishness slightly, but the stance remains clearly accommodative.
